title: SOP-PUR-001 Supplier Onboarding
summary: Standard operating procedure for onboarding suppliers in Ledgerline, including mandatory vendor documentation, manager approvals, and manual UN 38.3 compliance checks.
body:
SOP-PUR-001 defines the operational workflow for qualifying and creating new vendor accounts in Ledgerline [^r6]. As of 26 October 2026, version 3.1 governs all onboarding, enforcing mandatory documentation, anti-duplicate directory queries, and explicit purchase manager authorization [^r6][^r11]. Because automated Ledgerline certificate verification remains disabled under parameter PUR.CERT_CHK, manual verification of [[topic-un-38-3-certificates|UN 38.3 certificates]] via physical checklist form NBC-F-113 serves as the primary compliance control for [[items-bat|lithium-cell]] suppliers [^r18][^r33][^r40].

## Steps

1. **Pre-screening and Duplicate Check:** Before compiling an onboarding file, the proposer must query [[screen-pur-sup-03|PUR-SUP-03]] by company name, city, and VAT number, appending printed results to the dossier to prevent duplicate accounts [^r2][^r7][^r23][^r35]. Proposers should search using one short, distinctive word of the name with wildcard strings around key terms, checking variations and reviewing active and suspended records as well as postal locations [^r7][^r36][^r37][^r38]. Transaction histories of potential matches must be verified against past purchase orders [^r39].
2. **Onboarding Proposal:** A prospective vendor not currently in the master must be onboarded using form NBC-F-112 (Supplier Onboarding Request) when approaching Northbridge or submitting a quotation [^r8][^r19][^r34]. The request requires at least one written quotation and an operational justification demonstrating why existing master suppliers cannot fulfill the requirement [^r1][^r8]. Quotations cannot be formally accepted, and prospective purchase orders must be held from release, until onboarding completes [^r19][^r20].
3. **Document Collation:** The proposer must collate the mandatory paperwork specified in [[pol-sup-003|POL-SUP-003]] §3.2: company registration number, VAT registration certificate, bank letter detailing account information, proof of insurance, and a signed Supplier Code of Conduct [^r3][^r9][^r25][^r30].
4. **UN 38.3 Test Report Collation:** For suppliers of lithium-cell parts, the proposer must obtain a UN 38.3 test report and test summary for each part issued within the last 12 months, with a valid-to date at least 60 days past the planned first order date as required by [[amd-sup-2026-02|AMD-SUP-2026-02]] [^r10][^r26].
5. **Manager Approval:** The purchase executive or proposer submits the completed onboarding pack to [[user-dokafor|Daniel Okafor]], who must sign box 7 of form NBC-F-112 before any ledger record is generated [^r4][^r11][^r24][^r41].
6. **Master Record Creation:** Following manager sign-off, the proposer creates the vendor on [[screen-pur-sup-01|PUR-SUP-01]] using service sup_create in [[services-pur-sup|services-pur-sup]], entering the legal name, city, two-letter country code, payment terms, and VAT number without spaces [^r5][^r12]. The system issues a supplier code and displays `SUPPLIER <code> CREATED`, activating the account immediately [^r12][^r18].
7. **Certificate Upload and Verification:** For lithium-cell components, the proposer uploads the UN 38.3 documentation on [[screen-pur-sup-01|PUR-SUP-01]] via the Certificates tab using service sup_cert_upload, specifying certificate type UN38.3, document reference, valid-to date, and the scanned test report until confirmed with `CERT SAVED` [^r13][^r27]. Senior buyer [[user-lmoreno|Luis Moreno]] must inspect the uploaded certificate against the report and initial checklist form NBC-F-113; no purchase order may be raised until this check is signed off [^r5][^r14][^r26].
8. **Bank Detail Verification:** Accounts payable must verify supplier bank details by telephoning the supplier using an independently confirmed number from its letterhead or website, never from the supplied bank letter or an email, pursuant to [[sop-ap-004|SOP-AP-004]] [^r15][^r28].
9. **Rate Contract Setup:** The purchase manager's office must establish the rate contract under [[sop-pur-004|SOP-PUR-004]] before purchase orders can retrieve pricing via Fetch on [[screen-pur-po-01|PUR-PO-01]] [^r16][^r29].

Standard onboarding requires five working days from receipt of a complete dossier, but lithium-cell suppliers require at least ten working days due to testing laboratory queries [^r17].

## Forms and screens

* **NBC-F-112 (Supplier Onboarding Request):** Form submitted with vendor quotations and justification, requiring approval in box 7 by the purchase manager [^r8][^r11][^r24].
* **NBC-F-113 (Supplier Onboarding Checklist):** Version 2.1 checklist owned by the Purchase department, recording supplier name, city, country, and VAT number, and tracking steps 1 through 7 [^r21][^r22][^r23][^r24][^r25][^r26][^r27][^r28][^r29]. It serves as the sole operational control for certificate checks while PUR.CERT_CHK is disabled [^r18].
* **[[screen-pur-sup-03|PUR-SUP-03]] (Supplier Enquiry):** Screen used for pre-screening searches by keyword, city, and VAT number [^r2][^r7].
* **[[screen-pur-sup-01|PUR-SUP-01]] (Supplier Master Create):** Screen used for record generation via sup_create and certificate attachment via sup_cert_upload [^r12][^r13].
* **[[screen-pur-po-01|PUR-PO-01]] (Purchase Order Entry):** Screen where price retrieval depends on completed rate contracts [^r16].

## Versions and conflicts

* **Superseded record creation and turnaround (2026-09-01 vs legacy):** Under SOP-PUR-001 v3.1, the purchase proposer creates the account directly on PUR-SUP-01 upon purchase manager sign-off, turnaround is five days (ten for lithium parts), and UN 38.3 test summaries must be validated prior to any order placement [^r5][^r11][^r12][^r17]. Under superseded v2.0 (effective 2021-02-01) and legacy intranet guidelines, packs were forwarded to finance/accounts to create records on screen SUPP-ENT (or legacy SUPP-ENQ search), turnaround was three working days, and battery suppliers were permitted three months post-order to provide UN 38.3 reports [^r31][^r42][^r43][^r45][^r46]. Kind: `superseded`.
* **System certificate enforcement vs manual control (2026-10-07):** Ledgerline parameter PUR.CERT_CHK is set to `N` at Northbridge, meaning the ERP does not block purchase orders for missing or expired certificates [^r18]. Although [[rn-7-2-3-p4|RN-7.2.3-P4]] introduced automated checks, change decision CR-2026-031 deferred activation until at least January 2027, leaving physical checklist NBC-F-113 as the governing operational control [^r18][^r33][^r40]. Kind: `email_overrides_sop`.

r1.loc_text: p. 3, Appendix A. Guidance for proposers
r1.quote: Before gathering administrative paperwork, the proposer must secure at least one written quotation from the proposed vendor. In addition, the proposer must draft a clear statement explaining why no current vendor already present in the supplier master can meet the commercial or technical requirement.

r2.loc_text: p. 3, Appendix A. Guidance for proposers
r2.quote: To avoid creating duplicate vendor accounts, the proposer must search the supplier master in Ledgerline using screen PUR-SUP-03 prior to assembling further papers. The search must be performed thoroughly across multiple criteria: by company name, by city, and by VAT registration number.

r3.loc_text: p. 3, Appendix A. Guidance for proposers
r3.quote: Every file submitted for approval must contain the company registration number, the VAT registration certificate displaying the VAT number, and a formal bank letter confirming the account name, sort code, and account number. The proposer must also collect current proof of insurance matching company standards, together with a copy of the Supplier Code of Conduct signed by an authorised officer of the vendor.

r4.loc_text: p. 4, Appendix A. Guidance for proposers
r4.quote: The complete onboarding file is then passed to the purchase manager for formal review. The purchase executive must not attempt to create the vendor account in the system until the purchase manager has reviewed the file and granted written approval.

r5.loc_text: p. 4, Appendix A. Guidance for proposers
r5.quote: Following approval from the purchase manager, the proposer or authorised user creates the new supplier record in Ledgerline using screen PUR-SUP-01. The account is set to active status immediately upon entry. If the vendor supplies battery parts, the proposer must ensure the UN 38.3 certificate is uploaded against the vendor record under the correct certificate classification, recording the proper document reference and valid-to date.

r6.quote: Document SOP-PUR-001 Version 3.1 Effective 2026-09-01 Owner Luis Moreno (senior buyer) Approved by Daniel Okafor (purchase manager)

r7.quote: Search the supplier master first: on PUR-SUP-03, search by one short, distinctive word of the name, then by city, then by VAT number.

r8.quote: Raise the onboarding request on form NBC-F-112 (Supplier Onboarding Request), with at least one written quotation and the reason an existing supplier cannot meet the need.

r9.quote: Collect the documents listed in POL-SUP-003 §3.2: VAT registration certificate, company registration number, bank letter, proof of insurance and the signed Supplier Code of Conduct.

r10.quote: Check the dates against AMD-SUP-2026-02: the report must have been issued within the last 12 months, and its valid-to date must be at least 60 days after the planned date of the first order.

r11.quote: The purchase manager approves by signing box 7 of form NBC-F-112. Do not create the supplier before this signature.

r12.quote: Create the supplier on PUR-SUP-01 (service sup_create) with the name, city, two-letter country code, VAT number and payment terms. Ledgerline generates the supplier code and shows SUPPLIER <code> CREATED in the status bar.

r13.quote: Upload the UN 38.3 certificate on the Certificates tab of the supplier (service sup_cert_upload): certificate type UN38.3, the document reference and the valid-to date, with the scanned test report attached. The status bar shows CERT SAVED.

r14.quote: The senior buyer checks the uploaded certificate against the test report and initials the onboarding checklist (form NBC-F-113). No order for a lithium-cell part may be raised until the checklist is initialled.

r15.quote: Accounts payable verifies the bank details by calling the supplier back on a number taken from its letterhead or website, never from the bank letter or an e-mail (SOP-AP-004).

r16.quote: The purchase manager's office sets up the rate contract (SOP-PUR-004). Until it exists, Fetch on PUR-PO-01 has no contract rate to fill.

r17.quote: Allow five working days from a complete file (POL-SUP-003 §3.6). For a supplier of lithium-cell parts, allow at least ten working days: the certificate check often needs questions back to the supplier's test laboratory.

r18.quote: A new supplier is ACTIVE the moment it is created, and Ledgerline does not check certificates when an order is saved (parameter PUR.CERT_CHK is N at Northbridge). The checklist in step 5.8 is the only control.

r19.quote: A quotation from a supplier that is not in the supplier master starts the onboarding procedure (SOP-PUR-001). It may not be accepted until the supplier is onboarded.

r20.section: What to do when something does not look right
r20.loc_text: p. 4, What to do when something does not look right
r20.quote: Hold the order in the system immediately. Do not release the order to the supplier. Direct the requisitioning team to begin onboarding under the standard operating procedure

r23.quote: Supplier master searched by name, city and VAT number; result attached | Proposer

r24.quote: NBC-F-112 signed by the purchase manager (box 7) | Proposer

r25.quote: VAT certificate, company number, bank letter, insurance, Code of Conduct on file | Proposer

r26.quote: UN 38.3 report issued within 12 months; valid to at least 60 days after the first order | Senior buyer

r27.quote: Certificate uploaded as UN38.3 with document reference and valid-to date | Proposer

r28.quote: Bank details verified by call-back (SOP-AP-004) | Accounts payable

r29.quote: Rate contract entered | Purchase manager's office

r30.quote: When proposing a new vendor for raw materials, frame fittings, or electrical assemblies, staff must submit the standard trade questionnaire together with proof of quality standards and insurance cover.

r31.quote: Once the purchasing manager approves the submission, accounts will create the ledger entry and open the account for order placement.

r33.quote: The manual check in SOP-PUR-001 stays the control.

r34.quote: Luis to send the onboarding pack (SOP-PUR-001) and ask for their UN 38.3 report.

r35.section: How to search for a supplier properly
r35.loc_text: How to search for a supplier properly
r35.quote: Please ensure everyone takes care when looking up vendor records before raising any purchase documentation or asking for a new account to be opened.

r36.file: 09_email_archive/2025/2025-09-15_How to search for a supplier properly.eml
r36.section: How to search for a supplier properly
r36.loc_text: How to search for a supplier properly
r36.quote: Try searching using partial strings, with wildcard symbols around the key word. Check for common variations, such as whether a firm includes words like engineering, manufacturing, or components

r37.file: 09_email_archive/2025/2025-09-15_How to search for a supplier properly.eml
r37.section: How to search for a supplier properly
r37.loc_text: How to search for a supplier properly
r37.quote: Searching by the postal town or the county often brings up the correct account straight away if the legal entity name has changed following a restructuring.

r38.file: 09_email_archive/2025/2025-09-15_How to search for a supplier properly.eml
r38.section: How to search for a supplier properly
r38.loc_text: How to search for a supplier properly
r38.quote: Please review both active and suspended accounts as well, as an old record can often be reinstated by accounts payable rather than starting afresh.

r39.file: 09_email_archive/2025/2025-09-15_How to search for a supplier properly.eml
r39.section: How to search for a supplier properly
r39.loc_text: How to search for a supplier properly
r39.quote: If you find a record that looks like a match, check the historical transaction details against past purchase orders to confirm the address and contact details.

r40.file: 09_email_archive/2026/2026-10-07_Certificate check in Ledgerline (PUR.CERT_CHK) - stays off for now.eml
r40.quote: Until then nothing changes: the certificate check is yours, as in SOP-PUR-001.

r41.quote: they have to be onboarded first under SOP-PUR-001: the file, Daniel's signature on NBC-F-112, then the supplier is created and the UN 38.3 certificate uploaded.

r42.quote: purchasing staff gather the necessary business documentation from the prospective vendor and pass the completed pack to the finance team. Once accounts staff verify the details, they create the new vendor account in the legacy ERP system

r43.quote: Search the supplier list on screen SUPP-ENQ (Ledgerline 6 menu: Masters > Vendors).

r45.quote: Create the vendor on SUPP-ENT. Battery pack suppliers must send a UN 38.3 report within three months of the first order.

conflicts.today: Purchasing creates the supplier account directly on PUR-SUP-01 upon Daniel Okafor's sign-off on form NBC-F-112, with battery UN 38.3 test summaries required before ordering.
conflicts.other: Under superseded SOP-PUR-001 v2.0 (effective 2021-02-01) and legacy intranet guidance, finance/accounts created accounts on SUPP-ENT, turnaround was three working days, and battery reports could arrive within three months of first order.

conflicts.today: Verification of supplier certificates relies strictly on manual checking and physical checklist NBC-F-113 because system parameter PUR.CERT_CHK remains disabled in Ledgerline.
conflicts.other: System parameter PUR.CERT_CHK was patched in RN-7.2.3-P4 to validate certificates automatically, but management deferred enabling the check until at least January 2027.
